clues.text: An earless robotic blue feline sent backward in time from the future.
Will happily abandon all logic and morals for sweet Japanese bean pancakes.
A lazy, clumsy schoolboy who cries hysterically after scoring zero on tests.
Pulls reality-bending futuristic gadgets directly from a small four-dimensional belly pocket.
Flying across town skies using small yellow propeller hats stuck on heads.
A neighborhood bully who forces terrified friends to attend his ear-bleeding concerts.
Every 2000s Indian kid desperately prayed for memory bread before final exams.
A cheerful Hindi dub anthem celebrating wish fulfillment and joyful childhood skies.
A five-year-old menace who constantly embarrasses his mother in grocery stores.
Drops his trousers to perform an unfiltered dance waving his bare backside.
Devours royal star chocolate biscuit snacks while completely refusing to eat capsicum.
A fluffy white stray dog who displays vastly more maturity than him.
Cheekily asks pretty older women if they happen to enjoy green peppers.
Mother violently twists his temples with clenched fists after ridiculous public antics.
A wealthy preschool rival with curled hair who secretly enjoys commoner snacks.
Indian parents fiercely protested and petitioned television channels to ban this show.
An alien martial artist who forgets world-ending dangers if food is nearby.
Spends three consecutive episodes screaming loudly to turn black hair bright gold.
A proud, widow-peaked alien prince whose ego gets bruised in every fight.
An arrogant galactic tyrant who survives on an exploding planet for minutes.
Raising both hands to the sky asking entire planets for borrowed energy.
Consumes towering mountain stacks of roast meats in seconds after healing chambers.
Boys unironically spent recess trying to fire blue energy beams from palms.
Crushes a high-tech eyepiece after reading a combat power level over nine-thousand.
An orphaned prankster ninja who dreams of leading his hidden woodland village.
Resolves generational hatred and cosmic war simply by delivering heartfelt emotional lectures.
Spends entire ninja mission stipends slurping massive bowls of pork-broth ramen.
An emo rival driven by vengeance whose hair resembles a duck's tail.
A masked mastermind who declares global war because his childhood crush died.
Kids leaned forward sprinting down school hallways with arms locked straight behind.
Summoning hundreds of identical physical shadow clones to overwhelm a single enemy.
Constantly affirms his unwavering ninja way of never breaking a personal promise.
An eternal ten-year-old trainer who took two whole decades to win championships.
A chubby yellow electric rodent who stubbornly refuses to enter his sphere.
Unleashes a devastating hundred-thousand-volt lightning blast on command against opposing beasts.
A bumbling criminal duo and talking cat who blast off into skies.
Spinning his red baseball cap backward right before throwing a capsule ball.
Dubbed western localizations ridiculously tried calling triangular seaweed rice-balls glazed donuts.
An adrenaline-fueled rock anthem declaring the desire to become the absolute best.
School kids traded collectible holographic pocket-monster cards like illicit stock market currencies.
A brilliant high-school genius who develops a psychotic god complex over stationery.
Writing someone's real name while picturing their face causes sudden fatal heart-attacks.
A barefoot sugar-addicted detective who sits crouched on chairs with high knees.
A terrifying winged death god who experiences physical withdrawal fits without apples.
Dramatically writing names inside a concealed miniature television while eating potato chips.
Consuming mountains of red apples to satisfy a bored demonic winged companion.
Indian teenagers wrote enemies' names in blank diaries feeling edgy and dangerous.
Smirking maniacally while declaring that the entire plan unfolded exactly as intended.
A straw-hat-wearing rubber pirate who cannot swim even an inch in seawater.
Stretches his limbs like elastic bands before delivering high-speed pistol punches.
Devours giant cooked bone-in meat roasts while sleeping peacefully at banquet tables.
A green-haired swordsman who wields three blades, holding the third in teeth.
Corrupt world government nobles wearing glass bubble helmets to avoid breathing peasant air.
Shooting down the World Government flag to rescue an imprisoned archaeologist crewmate.
Loudly proclaims his ultimate destiny of reigning supreme as king of pirates.
College anime fans gatekeep newcomers by bragging about watching over one-thousand episodes.
An angry youth who swears vengeance against flesh-eating giants after mother dies.
Bites into his own bleeding hand to transform into a towering behemoth.
A short, tea-drinking captain who obsessively dusts furniture when not slaying giants.
A colossal skinless head peaks terrifyingly over a fifty-meter stone perimeter wall.
Mindless smiling naked humanoids who chew through terrified civilians in city alleys.
Witnessed legendary high-octane parkour animation shifts between Wit Studio and MAPPA.
Bombastic German-infused choral chanting demanding warriors sacrifice their entire physical hearts.
Fans put their right fists over left chests to salute during screenings.
A cap-wearing kid whose spinning toy houses a mythical azure holy dragon.
Yanks a plastic ripcord furiously to summon cosmic bit-beasts into metal stadiums.
A scarf-wearing brooding Russian rival with a legendary silver holy phoenix spirit.
Mad scientists seeking to extract and harvest celestial spirits from mechanical tops.
Screams a three-word rip command at top volume before launching spinning battle-tops.
Two plastic spinning tops clash so hard they shatter concrete warehouse floors.
Indian kids battled inside blue plastic washtubs after stealing their mothers' basins.
High-octane hard-rock guitars screeching about spinning metal gears and destiny clashes.
A completely bald hero for fun who suffers chronic depression from invincibility.
Obliterates multi-story cosmic terrors and mountain ranges with a single casual jab.
A serious blond cyborg who takes meticulous study notes on basic calisthenics.
A massive pot of steaming hot nabemono eaten with cheap cabbage leftovers.
Panic-sprints across the city in mid-battle terrified of missing supermarket discount sales.
A colossal extraterrestrial conqueror whose armor shatters before receiving consecutive regular punches.
Gym-bros unironically challenged themselves to the hundred-pushup daily fitness routine without AC.
JAM Project screaming pure metal fury that shakes your earphones' speaker cones.
A blue-clad boy ninja who lives secretly with an ordinary modern family.
Throws ninja stars, walks on walls, and rolls across ceilings effortlessly.
A crying toddler ninja in yellow whose high-pitched wails shatter window glass.
A sneaky rival ninja who conspires with an anthropomorphic black street cat.
Can be bribed or distracted instantly with crispy fried fish cakes.
Paralyzed with pure terrified panic whenever a slimy green frog hops near.
Running horizontally across wall tiles while throwing cloth smoke bombs to vanish.
Chants a repetitive rhythmic two-syllable ninja sound effect after finishing sentences.
An inventive schoolboy wearing a sun visor who deciphers ancient technological scrolls.
A lovable samurai robot crafted out of empty tin cans and balls.
The tin robot insists on eating round croquettes for every single meal.
Assembles miraculous time machines and shrinking lamps inside an ordinary bedroom workshop.
A bully whose family runs a greengrocer vegetable shop with stern discipline.
An older college student neighbor perpetually fails university entrance exams every year.
Constructing complicated contraptions overnight by reading handwritten medieval encyclopedia blueprints by lamplight.
A nostalgic upbeat track that 2000s kids still sing while reminiscing school.
A short, orange-haired dynamo determined to jump higher than tall giants.
Spikes aerial volleyball sets with eyes squeezed shut at blinding lightning speed.
A dictatorial setter prodigy who demands absolute perfection on every ball toss.
Devours steaming pork buns eagerly at the local corner store after practice.
A tiny spiker leaps above a towering three-man blocker wall at net.
Production I.G animating squeaking gym sneaker soles with heart-stopping cinematic tension.
College students suddenly joined campus volleyball courts pretending to be elite spikers.
High-octane J-Rock anthems by SPYAIR and Burnout Syndromes that pump adrenaline.
A gentle charcoal-seller carrying his cursed demon sister inside a wooden backpack.
Slices blades with breathing styles that summon roaring water waves and sunbursts.
A cowardly swordsman who only fights when passed out completely dead asleep.
An ancient progenitor demon king who uncanny-resembles pop singer Michael Jackson.
Ufotable delivers digital flame and water effects that broke world animation budgets.
Severing glowing demonic threads under a blood-red moon with dancing fire steps.
A boar-headed warrior hungrily snatches tempura fried prawns right off dining plates.
Green and black checkered haori cloaks flooded college anime conventions everywhere.
A high-school track star who swallows a rotten, thousand-year-old mummified finger.
A white-haired, blindfolded teacher whose overwhelming power bends the entire universe balance.
Traps enemies inside a customized personal mental realm where attacks hit guaranteed.
A four-armed ancient king of curses who rests on a mountain of skulls.
The blindfolded sensei constantly gorges on sweet desserts to fuel his brain.
Pulling down a black eye blindfold to reveal glowing, infinite blue eyes.
Eve and King Gnu tracks with stylish urban Tokyo jazz and guitars.
The internet suffered widespread collective grief when a beloved sorcerer got halved.
A short, golden-braided alchemist sporting metal prosthetic limbs who despises drinking milk.
A gentle younger brother whose soul is bound to giant hollow armor.
Claps hands together without drawing transmutation circles to reshape earth and stone.
Seven artificial homunculi representing deadly biblical sins birthed from a shadowy flask.
Flies into uncontrollable blinding rages whenever anyone jokes about his small height.
A grieving officer notes it is raining heavily on a cloudless day.
A crimson philosopher's stone secretly condensed from thousands of agonized human souls.
Permanently occupies the absolute number-one ranking spot across internet anime rating databases.
An orange-haired high-school delinquent who can see ghosts and wields oversized swords.
Screams a two-word release command to unlock black, high-speed ultimate bankai forms.
A treacherous glasses-wearing captain who slicks back his hair and leaves heaven.
Stopping the hero's giant sword blade effortlessly using just a single index-finger.
The feudal afterlife realm of the Soul Society guarded by thirteen court squads.
The villain claims every single event in your life was planned by him.
Orange Range delivering ultra-cool 2000s rap-rock accompanied by iconic urban graffiti graphics.
Teenagers practiced drawing hollow masks on their faces using black marker pens.
A green-haired, powerless crybaby who inherits cosmic strength by eating stray hair.
Channels stockpiled kinetic energy while shattering his own arm bones in combat.
An explosive childhood rival who screams murderous threats while winning school tournaments.
A half-fire, half-ice classmate who initially refuses using father's fiery left side.
A muscular symbol of peace points into cameras declaring you are next.
A decaying, scratch-prone sociopath adorned with preserved severed human hands over face.
A Latin phrase shouted to remind heroes to go beyond their limits.
The fandom became infamous for obsessively arguing about teenage superhero romance ships.
A Tokyo city boy who wakes up inside a rural countryside girl's body.
Swapping consciousness across different physical bodies on random days during morning sleep.
A braided red cord ribbon connecting two souls across different temporal timelines.
Passing each other silently on a red staircase in Tokyo years after catastrophe.
A picturesque rural mountain lake town threatened by an approaching split-tail comet.
Makoto Shinkai's breathtaking photorealistic skies, clouds, passing trains, and lens flares.
RADWIMPS delivering soaring Japanese rock ballads that make entire cinemas tear up.
Tourists flock to Shinjuku to photograph the real-life stairs from the poster.
A green-suited island boy who fishes for monsters to find his father.
A silver-haired ex-assassin boy who skateboards and channels deadly electric lightning aura.
Chants rock-paper-scissors in Japanese before unleashing a devastating, concentrated aura punch.
A bloodthirsty jester magician who gets unnervingly aroused fighting strong young prodigies.
Sacrificing his entire future lifespan to sprout towering hair and crush enemies.
Pork and rice platters devoured during grueling survival exams on uncharted continents.
Fans spend literal years in agony waiting through the creator's chronic hiatuses.
The exact same upbeat trumpet anthem played across all one-hundred-forty-eight episodes.
